chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ja'far bin Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The quickest of the evil to receive punishment is transgression (al-baghyu).'
ai.seo_question: What is the evil whose punishment is quickest according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), identifies 'al-baghyu'—defined in Shia jurisprudence as exceeding one's rightful limits or encroaching upon others' rights—as the sin with the swiftest divine retribution. Scholars emphasize this immediacy to warn against sudden, unexpected punishment for those who aggressively transgress boundaries, distinguishing it from sins that may be delayed for repentance. The concept underscores the urgency of maintaining justice and proportionality in both individual conduct and communal relations.
